package.description: Weekday commute update email automation generated from travel export.

workflows.name: Main
workflows.description: Primary travel commute update orchestration entry point.

steps.notes: Seed entry workflow so local build has an explicit main workflow.

processNodes.name: Weekday Commute Update Trigger
processNodes.description: Run unattended every weekday at 06:30 Europe/London.

processNodes.name: Load Commute Parameters
processNodes.description: Load RM14 1BT to EC2N 4BQ, depart 07:00, start station Upminster.

processNodes.name: Resolve Locations to Coordinates
processNodes.description: Resolve home and office locations to coordinates.

processNodes.name: Get Weather Forecast for 07:00
processNodes.description: Get morning weather forecast for origin area.

processNodes.name: Get London Underground Line Status
processNodes.description: Get relevant underground status including District line.

processNodes.name: Get National Rail c2c Service Status
processNodes.description: Get c2c and National Rail service status.

processNodes.name: Determine Scheduled Fastest Route Template
processNodes.description: Determine scheduled fastest route from Upminster to Bank or Monument area.

processNodes.name: Disruption Impacts Scheduled Route
processNodes.description: Determine whether current disruptions materially impact the scheduled route.

processNodes.name: Build Normal Summary Content
processNodes.description: Build normal summary with weather, no material disruptions, and fastest route.

processNodes.name: Build Disruption Context Pack
processNodes.description: Build disruption context with affected lines, severity, c2c status, and District fallback.

processNodes.name: Agent Draft Commute Email
processNodes.description: Use UiPath Agents and Azure OpenAI to draft a clear commute recommendation email.

processNodes.name: Draft Meets Safety and Format Rules
processNodes.description: Validate drafted content against safety and format rules.

processNodes.name: Create Human Review Task
processNodes.description: Create Action Center task to approve or edit the email.

processNodes.name: Apply Approved or Edited Email Text
processNodes.description: Apply Action Center edits back into the final email content.

processNodes.name: Assemble Final Email
processNodes.description: Assemble final subject and body for the commute update email.

processNodes.name: Send Email via Gmail Connector
processNodes.description: Send the commute update email to sumeet.Sangawar@outlook.com using Gmail connector ninemush@gmail.com.

storageBuckets.name: travel-commute-update
storageBuckets.description: Stores travel prompt and evidence artifacts

agents.description: TravelCommuteDraftingAgent for safe commute briefing generation.
guardrails: Escalate unsafe draft to Action Center
